1: /**
2:  * ThetaDecay — computes per-cell staleness via exponential decay.
3:  * Spec: foundations/16 §6, foundations/24 §3.2
4:  */
5: 
6: export interface ThetaParams {
7:   readonly halfLife: number; // ms — default time for staleness to reach 0.5
8:   readonly bleedThreshold: number; // 0-1 — staleness above this triggers bleed-through
9:   readonly lineHalfLives?: Record<string, number>; // per-line half-life overrides
10: }
11: 
12: export const DEFAULT_THETA_PARAMS: ThetaParams = {
13:   halfLife: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 7 days
14:   bleedThreshold: 0.7,
15:   // G.27: Per-line theta decay — different lines decay at different rates
16:   lineHalfLives: {
17:     Somatic: 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,      // 3 days (body memory fades fast)
18:     Willpower: 4 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,     // 4 days
19:     Emotional: 5 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,     // 5 days
20:     Interpersonal: 5 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 5 days
21:     Cognitive: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,     // 7 days (default)
22:     Intrapersonal: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 7 days
23:     Moral: 8 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,         // 8 days
24:     Spiritual: 10 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,    // 10 days (spiritual insights persist)
25:   },
26: };
27: 
28: /** Compute staleness score (0 = fresh, 1 = fully decayed) for a single cell. */
29: export function computeCellStaleness(lastEncounterMs: number, now: number, halfLife: number): number {
30:   const elapsed = now - lastEncounterMs;
31:   if (elapsed <= 0) return 0;
32:   return 1 - Math.pow(0.5, elapsed / halfLife);
33: }
34: 
35: /** Compute staleness for all cells. Key format: `${line}:${stage}` */
36: export function computeStaleness(
37:   timestamps: Readonly<Record<string, number>>,
38:   now: number,
39:   params: ThetaParams = DEFAULT_THETA_PARAMS,
40: ): Record<string, number> {
41:   const result: Record<string, number> = {};
42:   for (const key of Object.keys(timestamps)) {
43:     const [line] = key.split(':');
44:     const halfLife = params.lineHalfLives?.[line] ?? params.halfLife;
45:     result[key] = computeCellStaleness(timestamps[key]!, now, halfLife);
46:   }
47:   return result;
48: }
49: 
50: /**
51:  * Apply urgency power curve to raw staleness.
52:  * Spec: foundations/24 §3.2.1 - gentle at low decay, steep at high.
53:  */
54: export function computeUrgency(staleness: number): number {
55:   return Math.pow(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, staleness)), 1.5);
56: }
57: 
58: /** Return cell keys where staleness exceeds bleed-through threshold. */
59: export function detectBleedThrough(
60:   timestamps: Readonly<Record<string, number>>,
61:   now: number,
62:   params: ThetaParams = DEFAULT_THETA_PARAMS,
63: ): string[] {
64:   const staleness = computeStaleness(timestamps, now, params);
65:   return Object.entries(staleness)
66:     .filter(([_, s]) => s >= params.bleedThreshold)
67:     .map(([key]) => key);
68: }

# CCRPG — Cognitive-Capacity-Driven RPG

> 🚧 **Under Development** — Core architecture complete. First playable
> (Red stage vertical slice) ready for internal testing. Full 64-cell
> assessment module system implemented with 1,280 items across all 8
> stages.

An assessment-module-driven developmental RPG whose every gameplay
encounter is the gamification of a validated developmental assessment,
whose macro-progression is the eight stages of consciousness (64-cell
module architecture: 8 lines x 8 stages), and whose endgame is the
harvest into 4th-density unity in the canonical Law-of-One framing.
Built personally. Designed to be globally deployable. Adaptive to any
age, any developmental altitude.

---

## What this is

CCRPG is **two things at once**:

1. An assessment-module-driven developmental RPG with narrative arcs,
   immersive gameplay, and a 64-cell module architecture (8 lines of
   intelligence x 8 stages of consciousness). Every encounter is a
   module executing in one of four modes (calibration, encounter,
   practice, shadow work).
2. A **literal cognitive / developmental practice** -- every assessment
   module is a validated developmental exercise that simultaneously
   diagnoses AND heals/evolves the player. The game's progression IS
   the demonstration of integrated growth across all eight lines of
   intelligence.

The vision is documented in `docs/00-vision.md`. The binding build
plan is `UNIFIED-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md` at the repo root.

## The four canon decisions

| # | Decision |
|:-:|---|
| 1 | **Law-of-One layer = canon, fully integrated.** Seven energy rays as first-class types; harvest into 4th density as canonical endgame. |
| 2 | **No clinical / IRB ambition.** Commitment to *legitimate* neurological / biological / psychological efficacy via validated tasks and honest telemetry — without regulated medical-device certification. |
| 3 | **Adaptive onboarding for any age, any altitude.** Built personally, deployed globally. |
| 4 | **MVP = modular foundation of everything.** All 8 lines, 8 stages, 7 rays, 4 quadrants registered as modules at MVP launch. Red stage as the first vertical slice. Adding the rest is content drops. |

## Repository layout

```
CCRPG/
├── README.md                       <- you are here
├── UNIFIED-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md  <- the binding build plan
├── MVP-BLUEPRINT.md                <- vision & philosophy (implementation details superseded)
│
├── docs/                           <- the research foundation
│   ├── INDEX.md                    <- navigation
│   ├── REQUIREMENTS.md             <- the document-of-documents
│   ├── CHANGELOG.md                <- canon-decision history
│   ├── STAGE-ASSESSMENT-ARCHITECTURE.md <- module contract & execution modes
│   ├── ONBOARDING-REDESIGN-PLAN.md <- binary-search composite assessment
│   ├── 00-vision.md
│   ├── 01-first-principles.md
│   ├── 02-glossary.md
│   ├── 03-research-methodology.md
│   ├── foundations/                <- 28 theoretical foundations (00-27)
│   ├── lines/                      <- 8 lines of intelligence + overview
│   ├── stages/                     <- 8 stages of consciousness + overview
│   ├── progression/                <- progression overview
│   ├── narrative/                  <- narrative architecture
│   ├── archive/                    <- obsolete docs (combat/, enemies/, plan.md, etc.)
│   └── concept-drafts/             <- 512 game concept documents (64 modules x 8 files)
│
├── src/                            <- Phaser 3 + TypeScript scaffold (seed of MVP)
│   ├── core/                       <- pure TS -- domain & use cases
│   ├── infra/                      <- persistence + native bridges
│   └── game/                       <- Phaser scenes + UI + objects
│
├── tests/                          <- Vitest specs
└── public/                         <- static assets
```

## Status

| Layer | Status |
|---|---|
| Research / design documentation | ✅ Complete — 28 foundations + concept-drafts, canon-locked. |
| Concept-drafts (512 modules) | ✅ Complete — all 512 concept-drafts exist. |
| Unified build plan | ✅ Complete — `UNIFIED-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md` at repo root. |
| Implementation Phase 0: Legacy Removal | ✅ Complete — ATB removed, Significator is sole state vessel. |
| Implementation Phase 1: Core Architecture | ✅ Complete — Assessment engine, CCI, AutoMode, Scheduler, all 64 modules with 1,280 items. |
| Implementation Phase 2: First Playable | ✅ Complete — Full developmental loop, encounter selection UI, checkpoint system, accessibility layer. |
| Implementation Phase 3: Polish | ✅ Complete — Macro-catalyst engine, WorldState enrichment, transformation lifecycle. |
| Global deploy (web + Android) | ⏳ Planned. |

The `src/` contains the **full assessment-module architecture** —
64 registered modules (8 lines × 8 stages), each with 20 assessment
items, mode-aware execution (capacity/encounter/shadow/calibration/practice),
adaptive item selection, and the complete developmental loop from
CCI computation through encounter scheduling to Significator mutation.

## Quick start (the existing scaffold)

```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # local Vite dev server with HMR (open http://localhost:5173)
npm run build        # type-check + production bundle in dist/
npm test             # vitest unit tests for the core
```

Capacitor / Android targets:

```bash
npm run cap:sync     # build + cap sync
npm run cap:android  # build, sync, open in Android Studio
```

## Reading the documentation

If you have **30 minutes** and want the picture:

1. `docs/00-vision.md`
2. `docs/01-first-principles.md`
3. `UNIFIED-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md`

If you have **2 hours** and want the architecture:

1. The above
2. `docs/INDEX.md`
3. `docs/foundations/00-integral-theory.md`
4. `docs/foundations/06-law-of-one-correspondence.md` (the canon)
5. `docs/STAGE-ASSESSMENT-ARCHITECTURE.md`

If you want **all of it**, follow the reading order in `docs/INDEX.md`.

## Architecture in one paragraph

The codebase is split into three layers — `core/` (pure TypeScript,
no Phaser, no native, no network — runs in Node, in tests, in the
browser, anywhere a TS engine runs); `infra/` (I/O adapters —
persistence, native bridges, telemetry, locale); and `game/` (the
Phaser scenes that *visualise* the core). The MVP introduces eight
**registries** (`LineRegistry`, `StageRegistry`, `RayRegistry`,
`TaskRegistry`, `AbilityRegistry`, `EncounterRegistry`,
`DriveRegistry`, `NarrativeRegistry`) so that adding a new stage,
line, ray, task, ability, encounter, drive, or narrative beat is a
data-and-adapter change, never a rewrite.

## The eight-stage developmental arc, at a glance

| # | Stage | Energy ray | Defining capacity |
|:-:|---|---|---|
| 1 | Infrared / Archaic | Red | Survival, sensori-motor |
| 2 | Magenta / Magic | Orange | Symbol, magical agency |
| 3 | Red / Power | Yellow | Ego, will, dominance |
| 4 | Amber / Mythic | Green | Belonging, rule-and-role |
| 5 | Orange / Rational | Blue (in) | Reason, achievement |
| 6 | Green / Pluralistic | Blue (out) | Sensitivity, plurality |
| 7 | Turquoise / Integral | Indigo | Vision-logic, holism |
| 8 | White / Super-Integral | Violet | Non-dual, harvest |

Per-stage world bibles are in `docs/stages/`.

## The eight lines of intelligence

| Line | Quadrant home | Assessment style |
|---|---|---|
| Cognitive | UR | Planning, working-memory, Tower-of-London |
| Emotional | UL | Empathy reads, affect-regulation, mood recognition |
| Moral | UL->LL | Choice-based dilemmas, value-priority assessments |
| Intrapersonal | UL | Witness pause, self-tag, integrate |
| Spiritual | UL | State-shifting, value-priority modules |
| Somatic | UR | Rhythm, proprioception, breath-gated abilities |
| Willpower | UL->UR | Goal-locking, fatigue resistance |
| Interpersonal | LL | Co-op synergies, conflict resolution |

Per-line documents are in `docs/lines/`.

## Contributing

This project is **personally authored** by [@ishan-parihar](https://github.com/ishan-parihar)
and shipped globally. External contributions of the cognitive
content (cultural reviewers for affect-recognition stimuli,
linguistic localisation of narration, accessibility expertise) are
welcomed once the MVP is stable. Until then, please use Issues for
discussion. PRs against the early scaffold are accepted at the
maintainer's discretion.

A `CONTRIBUTING.md` will be added during Phase 5.

## License

License to be finalised before public deploy. The architectural
blueprint (now archived) and the entire `docs/` tree are provided
*as-is for study and reference*; the implementation, when complete,
will carry an explicit OSS license (MIT or Apache-2.0, leaning MIT).

## Acknowledgements

- **Ken Wilber** — Integral / AQAL theory; the eight-stage developmental
  framework
- **The Ra material** (L/L Research) — the seven-ray cosmology canonised
  into CCRPG's metaphysics
- **Adele Diamond, Akira Miyake, Naomi Friedman** — the executive-functions

- **Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi** — the flow-channel theory underpinning the
  staircase difficulty system
- **Jean Piaget, Lawrence Kohlberg, James Fowler, Jane Loevinger,
  Susanne Cook-Greuter, Robert Kegan** — the developmental-stages
  research synthesised into the eight-stage canon
- **Phaser**, **TypeScript**, **Vite**, **Capacitor**, **Vitest** — the
  technical foundation

The full bibliography will live in `docs/validation/BIBLIOGRAPHY.md`

1: /**
2:  * EncounterScheduler — selects and ranks encounters using the full priority formula.
3:  * Spec: foundations/24 (full)
4:  */
5: import type { PolarityMode, ShadowQuadrant } from '../domain/enums.js';
6: import type { ScheduledEncounter } from '../domain/EncounterSpecNew.js';
7: import type { Significator } from '../domain/Significator.js';
8: import type { ShadowEntry } from '../domain/ShadowLedger.js';
9: import { generateCandidates, type WorldState } from './CandidateGeneration.js';
10: import { computePriority, DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, type SessionContext, type PriorityWeights } from './PriorityComputation.js';
11: import type { TransformationPhase } from './TransformationDetector.js';
12: 
13: /** Threshold: if a line has more than this many unresolved shadows, shadow-work mode activates. */
14: const SHADOW_WORK_THRESHOLD = 3;
15: 
16: export type { WorldState } from './CandidateGeneration.js';
17: export type { SessionContext } from './PriorityComputation.js';
18: 
19: /**
20:  * Check if a line has exceeded the shadow-work threshold (>3 unresolved shadows).
21:  * When true, encounters for this line should use shadow execution mode.
22:  */
23: export function detectShadowWorkThreshold(sig: Significator, line: string): boolean {
24:   const unresolved = sig.shadows.entries.filter(
25:     (e: ShadowEntry) => e.line === line && e.resolvedAt === null,
26:   );
27:   return unresolved.length > SHADOW_WORK_THRESHOLD;
28: }
29: 
30: /**
31:  * Find the most active (highest severity) unresolved shadow quadrant for a line.
32:  * Returns null if no unresolved shadows exist for that line.
33:  */
34: export function findMostActiveShadowQuadrant(sig: Significator, line: string): ShadowQuadrant | null {
35:   const unresolved = sig.shadows.entries
36:     .filter((e: ShadowEntry) => e.line === line && e.resolvedAt === null)
37:     .sort((a: ShadowEntry, b: ShadowEntry) => b.severity - a.severity);
38:   return unresolved[0]?.quadrant ?? null;
39: }
40: 
41: /**
42:  * Schedule the next N encounters, ranked by priority.
43:  */
44: export function scheduleNext(
45:   sig: Significator,
46:   world: WorldState,
47:   session: SessionContext,
48:   now: number,
49:   count: number = 3,
50:   weights?: PriorityWeights,
51:   bleedThrough?: readonly string[],
52: ): ScheduledEncounter[] {
53:   const candidates = generateCandidates(sig, world, now, session);
54:   if (candidates.length === 0) return [];
55: 
56:   const scored = candidates.map(c => ({
57:     candidate: c,
58:     priority: computePriority(c, sig, world, session, now, weights, bleedThrough),
59:   }));
60: 
61:   // Sort descending by priority
62:   scored.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority);
63: 
64:   // Determine session position
65:   const progress = session.encountersSoFar / Math.max(1, session.targetSessionLength);
66:   const position: 'warmup' | 'peak' | 'cooldown' =
67:     progress < 0.2 ? 'warmup' : progress > 0.8 ? 'cooldown' : 'peak';
68: 
69:   // Determine polarity mode from significator
70:   const polarityMode: PolarityMode = sig.polarity.master.mode;
71: 
72:   // Determine shadow target from active shadows
73:   const activeShadow = sig.shadows.entries.find(e => e.resolvedAt === null);
74:   const shadowTarget: ShadowQuadrant | null = activeShadow?.quadrant ?? null;
75: 
76:   // G.9: Holonic Return — detect shadow-work threshold per-line
77:   // When a line accumulates >3 unresolved shadows, force shadow execution mode
78:   // and target the most active (highest severity) shadow quadrant for that line.
79:   const lineShadowModes = new Map<string, boolean>();
80:   const lineShadowTargets = new Map<string, ShadowQuadrant | null>();
81: 
82:   // Take top N, diversifying by line (no more than 2 from same line)
83:   const result: ScheduledEncounter[] = [];
84:   const lineCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
85:   const moduleRefs = new Set<string>();
86: 
87:   for (const { candidate, priority } of scored) {
88:     if (result.length >= count) break;
89:     const lc = lineCounts[candidate.line] ?? 0;
90:     if (lc >= 2) continue;
91:     // Deduplicate by moduleRef to prevent same encounter appearing multiple times
92:     if (moduleRefs.has(candidate.moduleRef)) continue;
93:     lineCounts[candidate.line] = lc + 1;
94:     moduleRefs.add(candidate.moduleRef);
95: 
96:     // G.9: Check shadow-work threshold for this candidate's line
97:     if (!lineShadowModes.has(candidate.line)) {
98:       lineShadowModes.set(candidate.line, detectShadowWorkThreshold(sig, candidate.line));
99:       lineShadowTargets.set(candidate.line, findMostActiveShadowQuadrant(sig, candidate.line));
100:     }
101:     const isShadowWork = lineShadowModes.get(candidate.line)!;
102:     const lineShadowTarget = lineShadowTargets.get(candidate.line) ?? shadowTarget;
103: 
104:     result.push({
105:       id: `${candidate.moduleRef}:${candidate.holonId}:${now}`,
106:       moduleRef: candidate.moduleRef,
107:       modality: candidate.modality,
108:       targetLines: [candidate.line],
109:       stage: candidate.stage,
110:       holonSource: candidate.holonId,
111:       shadowTarget: lineShadowTarget,
112:       polarityMode,
113:       difficulty: computeDifficulty(sig, candidate.line, candidate.stage),
114:       sessionPosition: position,
115:       priority,
116:       driveTarget: activeShadow?.drive ?? null,
117:       executionMode: isShadowWork ? 'shadow' : 'capacity',
118:     });
119:   }
120: 
121:   return result;
122: }
123: 
124: function computeDifficulty(sig: Significator, line: string, stage: string): number {
125:   // Difficulty relative to player's altitude in that line
126:   const key = `${line}:${stage}`;
127:   const cell = sig.polarity.cells[key];
128:   const traceCount = cell?.traceCount ?? 0;
129:   // More traces = more familiarity = lower difficulty; cap at 0.3-0.9
130:   return Math.max(0.3, Math.min(0.9, 0.9 - traceCount * 0.05));
131: }
132: 
133: /**
134:  * Threshold-mode scheduling: overrides normal scheduling during transformation.
135:  * Spec: foundations/24 §6.2
136:  */
137: export function scheduleThresholdMode(
138:   sig: Significator,
139:   world: WorldState,
140:   session: SessionContext,
141:   phase: TransformationPhase,
142:   now: number,
143: ): ScheduledEncounter[] {
144:   switch (phase) {
145:     case 'unravelling':
146:       return scheduleNext(sig, world, session, now, 3, {
147:         ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
148:         thetaUrgency: 0.10,
149:         shadowActivation: 0.35,
150:         transformationReadiness: 0.30,
151:         polarityAlignment: 0.10,
152:         driveCorrection: 0.05,
153:         narrativeCoherence: 0.05,
154:         sessionFit: 0.05,
155:       });
156:     case 'crucible':
157:       return scheduleNext(sig, world, session, now, 2, {
158:         ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
159:         thetaUrgency: 0.05,
160:         shadowActivation: 0.40,
161:         transformationReadiness: 0.35,
162:         polarityAlignment: 0.05,
163:         driveCorrection: 0.05,
164:         narrativeCoherence: 0.05,
165:         sessionFit: 0.05,
166:       });
167:     case 'emergence':
168:       return scheduleNext(sig, world, session, now, 3, {
169:         ...DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
170:         thetaUrgency: 0.05,
171:         shadowActivation: 0.10,
172:         transformationReadiness: 0.05,
173:         polarityAlignment: 0.20,
174:         driveCorrection: 0.10,
175:         narrativeCoherence: 0.30,
176:         sessionFit: 0.20,
177:       });
178:     default:
179:       return scheduleNext(sig, world, session, now, 3);
180:   }
181: }
